cohort: Pregnant patients with singleton pregnancies and intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) fetuses, excluding those with structural anomalies, attending the antenatal OPD Clinic at the Department of Obstetrics & Gynecology, Women Medical College, Abbottabad, and Women & Children Hospital Abbottabad from June 2019 to December 2019.
finding: Babies with abnormal umbilical artery Doppler had significantly more frequent abnormal umbilical artery blood gas status and lower Apgar scores.
